name: Juggernaut
fantasy: The wrecking ball. Gets hotter with every hit, chains you in, and finishes it.

card.loop: Every hit heats Rage: more damage, dash and cooldown haste. At 100, Enraged: your next Smash is a Rage Smash.
card.dash: Two charges of a short dash attack; its tip hits hardest. A knock refills both.
card.passive: Rage builds as you deal damage and grants damage, dash haste and ability haste; at 100, Enraged. Knocks heal you.
card.rmb: Tap: a heavy slam (more to the wounded). Hold: a charged lunge. In the air: a downward slam.
card.e: Chain a foe (healing blighted) or a wall; press E again to haul yourself to it.
card.r: Invulnerable as you rise, then a crushing strike that heals you; a knock resets it.

weapons.greatsword: Quick slashes; hold to charge a Searing Wave that rolls through everyone in a line.
weapons.minigun: Spin up, then a hose of rounds.

passive.name: Rage
passive.desc: Damage you deal heats your Rage (about +0.55 per point dealt), and losing health adds a little; it cools after 3s out of a fight. Rage gives up to +8% damage, +50% dash recharge and +35% cooldown speed. At 100 you're Enraged for 5s: +15% damage, everything at its fastest, and your next Smash is a Rage Smash. A knock heals you 15% of your health and refills Rampage.

dash.name: Rampage
dash.desc: A 4.4m dash attack (2 charges): foes along it take 6 and are shoved ahead; the tip at the end hits hardest, 14 and a big knock (stun 0.8 into a wall). A knock refills both charges.

variants.tap: Heavy Slam: a 3m cone, 18 damage and push 6; foes under 40% health take +60% (BREAK).
variants.hold: Lunge: charge 0.3 -> full at 0.9s, then drive 3 -> 7m into the first foe: 14 -> 26 damage and stun 0.25 -> 0.6.
variants.air: Meteor Drop: slam straight down, a 2.6m burst: 16 damage and slow 40% for 1.5s; the centre (1.2m) is stunned 0.8.
variants.full: Enraged: the next Smash is a Rage Smash: +60% damage, +50% knock, stun 0.5 (the payoff).

e.name: Warchain
e.desc: Throw a chain 9m: it hooks the first foe (8 damage) or bites a wall. For 4s a hooked foe is slowed 20% and blighted (healing barely takes) and can't get more than 10m away. Press E again to haul yourself to the chain's end: into a hooked foe for 10 and stun 0.35. A chain that hooks nothing refunds 60% of the cooldown.

r.name: Doomfall
r.desc: A 0.55s wind-up in which you're invulnerable, rising with the blade overhead (everyone sees where you'll land), then you crash down up to 5m ahead: a 3.2m strike, 36 damage and push 9, and you heal half the damage it deals. If anyone you hit is knocked within 2s, Doomfall's cooldown resets.

rank3.dash: the tip stuns 1.2 into a wall

rank2.ult: Rank 2 (level 9): cooldown 90s -> 76.5s, +15% damage; heals 70% of the damage.

rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 13s -> 10.4s, damage +30%; the chain reaches 11m.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 8s -> 5.6s; the tip stuns 1.2 into a wall.

tells.half: red heat glowing through the pauldrons, steam at 50+
tells.full: Enraged: a red shell, the hunter swells, a roar within 25m
